formulations: {name} is a model of lounge trousers for ordinary lounging at home.
For ordinary lounging at home, the {name} model supplies lounge trousers.
language.when: internal.recipe in literal_recipe_rows and sku in product.skus and sku.facts == product.facts and (True)

formulations: The model is declared in the {range} commercial range; this is not an anatomy or individual-fit statement.
Commercial model range: {range}, rather than a declaration of wearer anatomy or guaranteed fit.
language.when: internal.recipe in literal_recipe_rows and sku in product.skus and sku.facts == product.facts and (True)

formulations: Main cloth: loopback knitted fabric, 100% cotton. Pocket bags, sewing thread, drawstring and waist/leg elastics are outside that fibre declaration.
The loopback knitted main cloth is declared cotton 100%; this does not describe pocket bags, thread, cord or any attached elastic.
language.when: internal.recipe in literal_recipe_rows and sku in product.skus and sku.facts == product.facts and (product.facts.recipe_id == 'cotton_loopback_jogger')

formulations: Main cloth: plain woven fabric, 50% cotton and 50% polyester. Pocket bags, sewing thread, drawstring and waist/leg elastics are outside that fibre declaration.
The plain woven main cloth is declared cotton 50% and polyester 50%; this does not describe pocket bags, thread, cord or any attached elastic.
language.when: internal.recipe in literal_recipe_rows and sku in product.skus and sku.facts == product.facts and (product.facts.recipe_id == 'woven_blend_lounge')

formulations: Declared full-length model cut: {cut}, {thigh} thigh fit and {rise}; these labels do not establish individual body fit.
The full-length model declares {rise}, {thigh} thighs and a {cut}, without a universal fit promise.
language.when: internal.recipe in literal_recipe_rows and sku in product.skus and sku.facts == product.facts and (True)

formulations: One continuous attached elastic waistband and one internal waist drawstring adjusted and tied by hand; no fly opening, zip, button, hook-and-bar or belt loop is fitted.
The waistband has one attached continuous elastic band and one hand-adjusted internal drawstring to tie. There is no fly opening or fitted zip, button, hook-and-bar or belt loop.
language.when: internal.recipe in literal_recipe_rows and sku in product.skus and sku.facts == product.facts and (True)

formulations: Two gathered elasticated hems contain two attached leg elastic bands, one per leg; their composition is unspecified.
One elastic band in each of the two gathered hems gives two attached leg bands. Leg-elastic composition is unknown.
language.when: internal.recipe in literal_recipe_rows and sku in product.skus and sku.facts == product.facts and (product.facts.recipe_id == 'cotton_loopback_jogger')

formulations: Two plain turned-up hems have no attached leg elastic; leg-band count is zero and leg-elastic composition is inapplicable.
There are two plain turned-up leg hems and zero leg elastic bands; with no leg elastic, its composition does not apply.
language.when: internal.recipe in literal_recipe_rows and sku in product.skus and sku.facts == product.facts and (product.facts.recipe_id == 'woven_blend_lounge')

formulations: Three pockets total: two open front hand pockets and one open rear patch pocket; there are no thigh or coin pockets.
Two open front hand pockets plus one open patch pocket at the rear make three pockets, with no thigh pocket or coin pocket.
language.when: internal.recipe in literal_recipe_rows and sku in product.skus and sku.facts == product.facts and (product.facts.recipe_id == 'cotton_loopback_jogger')

formulations: Two pockets total, both open front hand pockets; there is no rear, thigh or coin pocket.
The two open front hand pockets are the whole pocket count; no rear pocket, thigh pocket or coin pocket is fitted.
language.when: internal.recipe in literal_recipe_rows and sku in product.skus and sku.facts == product.facts and (product.facts.recipe_id == 'woven_blend_lounge')

formulations: Separate fitted pocket bags are 100% cotton; this is not the main-cloth or lining declaration.
Pocket bags are fitted separately and declared cotton 100%, apart from main cloth and any garment lining.
language.when: internal.recipe in literal_recipe_rows and sku in product.skus and sku.facts == product.facts and (True)

formulations: No garment lining is fitted; lining material is inapplicable.
The model is unlined, so a garment-lining material does not apply.
language.when: internal.recipe in literal_recipe_rows and sku in product.skus and sku.facts == product.facts and (True)

formulations: Sewing-thread, waist-elastic and drawstring compositions are unspecified.
No composition is declared for sewing thread, the waist elastic or the attached drawstring.
language.when: internal.recipe in literal_recipe_rows and sku in product.skus and sku.facts == product.facts and (True)

formulations: This pair is {colour} and has the commercial label {size}; the label is not a body or garment measurement.
Commercial label {size}, colour {colour}: these are the selected pair's choices, not a measured size chart.
language.when: internal.recipe in literal_recipe_rows and sku in product.skus and sku.facts == product.facts and (True)

formulations: Declared finished long-garment inside-leg reference before washing: {inseam:g} cm. It is not a bought-pair or wearer measurement, size conversion or fit guarantee.
Before-washing nominal finished inside leg is declared {inseam:g} cm, rather than measured on the purchased pair or wearer; it does not convert a label into universal fit.
language.when: internal.recipe in literal_recipe_rows and sku in product.skus and sku.facts == product.facts and (True)

formulations: One assembled wearable garment, called one pair, is supplied. No top, belt, spare cord, care product, body-fit chart or removable garment piece is supplied; attached elastic, pockets and wrapping are not extra garments.
The purchase contains one assembled pair and no supplied top, belt, spare cord, care product, body-fit chart or removable garment piece. Attached parts and wrapping do not increase the garment count.
language.when: internal.recipe in literal_recipe_rows and sku in product.skus and sku.facts == product.facts and (True)

formulations: Actual bought-pair waist circumference and full inside leg are unspecified. Complete garment mass, including all attached parts but excluding packaging, is unmeasured.
No actual purchased-garment waist or full inside-leg measurement is supplied; complete garment mass with attached parts, without packaging, is also unspecified.
language.when: internal.recipe in literal_recipe_rows and sku in product.skus and sku.facts == product.facts and (True)

formulations: Main-cloth mass per area, measured stretch extension and measured first-wash shrinkage are unspecified; no stretch, cooling, breathability, elastic-life or sleep-quality result is declared.
No main-cloth area-mass, measured extension or measured first-wash shrinkage is supplied. Stretch, cooling, breathability, elastic lifetime and sleep-quality results are unspecified.
language.when: internal.recipe in literal_recipe_rows and sku in product.skus and sku.facts == product.facts and (True)

formulations: For the entire pair and attached parts: untie the waist cord, gently machine wash inside out with similar colours at a maximum {wash}°C programme setting; no bleach, tumble drying or dry cleaning. Hang to dry. Iron only main cloth up to {iron}°C, avoiding pocket bags, cord and all elastic. These are label settings, not measured temperatures or lifetime guarantees.

Whole-pair label care, including attached parts: untie the cord, gentle inside-out machine wash with similar colours at or below the {wash}°C programme setting, then hang dry. Do not bleach, tumble dry or dry-clean. Main cloth alone may be ironed to a {iron}°C maximum; avoid pocket bags, drawstring and any elastic. Settings are declarations, not measured temperatures or promised component life.
language.when: internal.recipe in literal_recipe_rows and sku in product.skus and sku.facts == product.facts and (True)

formulations: Whole-pair reference price for this {colour} pair labelled {size}: {price:g} SEK, including all attached components; this is not a live offer.
Reference price: {price:g} SEK for the entire {colour} pair with commercial label {size} and all attached parts, rather than a live retailer offer.
language.when: internal.recipe in literal_recipe_rows and sku in product.skus and sku.facts == product.facts and (True)
